source: computed from INDEX.jsonl post WF6-append (107 rows); includes WF3-D1 evidenced rows + WF6 new bundles
method: two-column: evidenced_full_leaf_100 (full_leaf_100=true in INDEX row) vs achievable_full_leaf_100_pending (full_leaf_100=false/null but achievable_full_leaf_100=true). relay rows flagged achievable_full_leaf_100=true are NOT excluded. 'other' rows carry neither flag.

evidenced_full_leaf_100.note_voice: voice 34 cmds accepted_substitute (backend absent); evidenced at module level via accepted_substitute_ida_backend_command_absence — product decision boundary: do_not_restore_voice_without_Product_decision

blocker_classes.dim6_C5_acceptance_test_not_written: system-hotspot(mac+win), system-usage(mac+win), maintenance(mac), window-path(mac), mystery-unlock(mac), api-proxy-config(mac), ui-theme(mac)
blocker_classes.dim6_pending_partial_commands: daemon-autoswitch(win: 4 absent cmds), system(mac: 5 product-decision cmds), system(win: 4 strictImpl cmds)

other_rows_neither_flag.note: Legacy single-command distilled rows, pre-v2 schema rows, rows with fl100=null and achievable_full_leaf_100 absent or false. These are pre-WF6 rows not yet migrated to wf6-bundle schema. Not counted in either column.

honesty_boundary: evidenced_full_leaf_100 != achievable. Only rows with full_leaf_100=true in INDEX count as evidenced. Achievable rows carry full_leaf_100=false/null + achievable_full_leaf_100=true + residual_steps. No empty 'done' on un-evidenced items. G2-LOCK §3 applies.
nonActions: no deletion of prior counts files
relay NOT excluded — reframed as dim6_pending achievable
old counts files marked STALE (not deleted)
